closure_method.name: Section-Closure Method (adopted 2026-09-14, supersedes the earlier hard 0-unverified-candidate gate)
closure_method.rule: For every section: discover, reconcile against authoritative sources, resolve all P0 (blocking) and cheap P1 gaps, run the section completeness checklist, then close. A section may close with AT MOST 1 non-blocking P2 residual, deferred to DEFERRED_SEMANTIC_VALIDATION_QUEUE rather than chased to forced closure. Never defer an item that could change: (1) semantic control count, (2) mode/type universe, (3) control ownership, (4) conditional UI, (5) structural topology, (6) cross-system relationship, (7) resource workflow, or (8) another section's inventory -- those are always P0.

tiers.P0: MUST_RESOLVE_NOW -- missing major control, missing mode/type, semantic-universe-changing control, conflicting ownership, topology-affecting structural op, conditionally-exposed parameter, suspected-duplicate/ownership conflict, cross-section-affecting control
tiers.P1: RESOLVE_IF_CHEAP -- answerable from already-available evidence (existing transcript/screenshot/official PDF) without new investigation
tiers.P2: DEFER -- narrow, non-blocking, would require disproportionate effort; max 1 per section, logged to the deferred queue with full context

records.label: Duplicate route policy

sources.ref: MATRIX panel, live Serum 2.0.21 UI, 2026-09-15, Phase 2C Test 2: three controlled scenarios executed. (A) Mod Wheel->Macro 1 duplicated exactly in a second row: ACCEPTED as independent route, Macro 1 modulator-count badge read 2, clearing one duplicate left the other fully intact. (B) Mod Wheel->Macro 2 added alongside Mod Wheel->Macro 1: ACCEPTED, no conflict. (C) Aftertouch->Macro 1 added alongside two Mod Wheel->Macro 1 routes: ACCEPTED, Macro 1 modulator-count badge read 3, confirming modulators stack/sum with no cap encountered.

records.notes: NEW RECORD 2026-09-15 (Phase 2C Test 2, formalized). The MATRIX imposes no uniqueness constraint on (SOURCE, DESTINATION) route pairs. Every route is an independent, separately-addressable object: duplicate SOURCE/DESTINATION pairs coexist without merging, replacing, or rejecting; clearing one route via SOURCE=Off never affects any other route, including an exact duplicate of itself. Destinations with multiple simultaneous modulators sum/stack (confirmed via Serum's own per-destination modulator-count badge incrementing correctly with each additional route).

records.notes: Itemized Phase 2A-R.9b (Clip Player routing resolution). CONDITIONAL_ON_ACTIVE_CLIP: Confirmed via read->mutate->readback->restore on the live VST3 parameter (idx 521, Clip Player Rate) plus structural body-state inspection (bridge.capture_v8_skeleton): ClipPlayer0 exists as a SINGLE object (like Global0, Arp0 -- not scaled to 12 instances), while the 12 clip slots' own note/timing data live in separate MidiClip0-MidiClip11 objects. There is no 'slot'/'select' VST3 parameter anywhere in the 2623-parameter space (searched exhaustively, twice). This parameter's own pre-existing discovery notes independently corroborate this: internal tooltip name is literally 'Clip N Playback Mode' (N = whichever clip is currently selected in the UI), not a fixed per-instance name. CONCLUSION: this is Decision (C) from the Phase 2A-R.9b determination table -- one conditional semantic representing 'the currently-active clip's value', NOT (A) a context-free global value and NOT (B) 12 independently MATRIX-routable per-slot targets. A MATRIX route to 'Clip Player Rate' can only ever affect whichever clip is currently active; it cannot independently target clip-slot-3 vs clip-slot-5 as separate automation destinations.
